title: Sample 18-1: Parts-of-Speech Labels Above the Sentence

illustrates.quote:
18.5.2 Option 1
a. Transcribe the sentence without the text printed above or below the line.
b. After the sentence, list the words above/below the line followed by a colon and provide the corresponding word(s) from the sentence.
c. Insert a transcriber’s note to explain the format.
18.5.3 Option 2
a. Place the abbreviation, word, or number in enclosure symbols not otherwise used in surrounding text (exercise set) and insert it after the affected text.

blocks.text: In braille, each sentence is followed by a list of the parts of speech appearing above the print line with their corresponding words.

print.notes: Option 1 (18.5.2) only; Option 2 (18.5.3) is the sample's own second half, kept in braille.variants (a print-side reconstruction of it is not attempted, since its own note wording and inline-parenthesis mechanism are already exercised in full by Sample 18-2's own Option 2 below).
print.printFeatures: The word "Philanthropists" is printed in bold; the word "donated" is printed in italics.

braille.notes: Re-extracted directly from the source's own numbered lines 1-9 (14804-14812), stripping the file's own 5-character line-number field (max line number 15, two digits, +3 = 5) and converting U+2800 to space; the print-only 'Option 1'/'Option 2' captions (14802/14813, not braille-ASCII, no line-number field of their own) are omitted, never treated as content. The trailing '#,-' at the end of line 1 is the book's own running braille page number (18-15), page furniture rather than sample content — never modeled.

resolution: Both runs merged Option 1 and Option 2 into one flat braille.lines array, including the print-only 'Option 1'/'Option 2' captions as if they were braille content and with no braille.variants split at all — inconsistent with how BOTH runs treated Sample 18-2 (which DOES split Option 2 into variants, captions excluded). Re-derived from source directly: Option 1 (lines 1-9, source 14804-14812) as braille.lines, Option 2 (lines 10-15, source 14815-14820) as a single braille.variants entry, both with the 5-char line-number field stripped and the captions dropped, matching Sample 18-2's own established convention and the variants schema already used elsewhere in this gold corpus ({label, lines}, tests/gold/bana-formats-2016/section-13/sample-13-03.json). NOTE: this task's own brief says "Samples 18-2 and 18-3 show two Options each" — the source does not support this: Sample 18-1 and Sample 18-2 are the two-Option samples (confirmed here and by Sample 18-2 below); Sample 18-3 has only one transcription (both runs' own uncertain fields independently already reached this same conclusion, and the source's own "(Return to Text)" at line 14898 confirms no Option 2 follows it) — settled from the source per this task's own instruction to do so whenever a claim (here, the brief's own) conflicts with it. illustrates.rule broadened from run A's own generic 18.5.1 (merely the two-options intro) to 18.5.2+18.5.3 (Option 1's and Option 2's own defining rules, both actually illustrated here).
